title: Fabrication of aramid-based antimicrobial polypropylene composite membranes functionalized with thiazolidine-based nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16607-16621
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00748H, Paper
Open Access

Javaria Kanwal, Sara Musaddiq, Sadia Iqbal, Faryal Nazar Balouch, Sajjad Ahmad, Mohammad Abul Farah, Mohammad Ajmal Ali, Francis Verpoort
The current research introduces advanced aramid-polypropylene composite membranes functionalized with thiazolidine-based nanoparticles (TNPs), which exhibit superior antimicrobial and antifouling properties for sustainable water treatment.
